title: Brew & Bloom
subtitle: Integrated launch campaign for an independent coffee shop
description:
PLACEHOLDER PROJECT — replace with your own coursework or internship work.

The brief

A neighbourhood coffee shop was opening a second location and had no awareness outside its original street. The goal was to fill the new store's first month without discounting.

What I did

  • Audience research with 40 short intercept interviews near the new site
  • Positioning around "your third place" rather than product or price
  • A four-week rollout across Instagram, local partnerships, and in-store signage

title: Unfiltered

description:

The idea

A weekly short-form video series testing whether unpolished, behind-the-scenes content outperforms produced brand video for a student audience.

What I did

  • Content calendar and hook formulas for TikTok and Reels
  • A/B tested thumbnail and first-three-seconds variants
  • Tracked retention and saves rather than raw views

What I learned
